text:
Maria (CS): Panacea pre-QBR sprint — noticed a 3x token spike in 48h after onboarding week. Need quick triage: organic vs import/test. Capture enablement gaps too.
Jake (AE): Noted. Renewal in ~8 weeks, $75k target. Would like a 10% spend reduction recommendation for QBR.
Anita (FinOps): Initial spend snapshot coming. Embeddings + rerank dominate. If current trend continues monthly spend jumps from ~$48k to ~$120k.
Ravi (SE): Quick ideas: reduce embed context window, enable prefix KV cache, pin to quantized model; also rate-limit bulk imports.
Lina (Customer): We did a large product-data import last night which likely explains the surge — sorry for the noise.
Maria (CS): Good catch. Let's separate import traffic. @Ravi can you add a dashboard filter for tag=import_job and a short alert?
Ravi (SE): Added filter + alert. Example rule: alert panacea_embed_rate if rate(requests{team="panacea",tag!~"import.*"}[5m]) > 200 for 10m.
Maria (CS): Anita — can you run two what-if scenarios by EOD: (A) keep import + throttle embeddings 50% (B) postpone import. Show impact to next invoice and commit runway.
Anita (FinOps): Will post numbers. Also: what's our flexibility on commit terms? @Jake
Jake (AE): We can offer a 60-day runway extension with mid-quarter commit review. I'll draft QBR language.
Maria (CS): Lina mentioned docs gap: bulk-embed example missing rate-limit and retry guidance. Lina, can you paste the snippet you used?
Lina (Customer): Snippet: POST /v1/embeddings body:{items:[...],model:"open-large"} — no rate-limit or retry example.
Ravi (SE): I'll draft README update that includes batching, backoff/retry codes, and an example using chunking; will PR and tag @docs.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Panacea onboarding checklist item 'data-import-notify' still open.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Ravi: dashboard filter + alert (2h) 2) Anita: scenario forecasts (EOD) 3) Jake: commit extension language (tomorrow) 4) Ravi/docs: batching & retry example PR. Lina will confirm new import ETA.
Lina (Customer): We'll postpone import to next Tue 03:00 UTC — should reduce the immediate spike.
Maria (CS): Marking blocked until import schedule confirmed. We'll reconvene after Anita posts the forecast. Thanks all :thumbsup:
